dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like you'll be waiting for a while more.

dialogues.speaker: Mamontov
dialogues.text: Yeah, looks like it. There was a young couple arguing here earlier — they were really going at it. The attendants didn't even lift a finger... Though I suppose there wasn't much they could do.

dialogues.speaker: Mamontov
dialogues.text: After that, the two of them just walked off in opposite directions. The child still here must be theirs. The poor thing must have a difficult home life.

dialogues.speaker: Mamontov
dialogues.text: Still, if the ticket clerk takes any longer with him, I'm going to be the one in trouble. Standing in line for long just to miss my train... That'd be so infuriating.
